ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In 2010, my country's industrial added value increased by 12.1% year-on-year. Read the chart and answer: <image1> To enable my country's industrial output value to grow sustainably, investment in which aspect needs to be increased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a combined bar-line chart of “Total Industrial Added Value and Its Growth Rate from 2006 to 2010.” The bars represent my country's total industrial added value, which as a whole shows an upward trend; the line represents the growth rate, marked with 12.9, 14.9, 9.9, 8.7, 12.1, etc., indicating that the growth rate fluctuated, and the question stem also points out that in 2010 it increased by 12.1% year-on-year. Then reason: Industrial output value has already grown, but to achieve long-term, stable, sustainable growth, it cannot rely only on extensive inputs such as resources and labor, but needs to improve production efficiency and promote industrial upgrading through technological progress. Therefore investment in science and technology should be increased.

raw_record.question_text:
In 2010, my country's industrial added value increased by 12.1% year-on-year. Read the chart and answer: <image1>
To enable my country's industrial output value to grow sustainably, investment in which aspect needs to be increased?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中柱状表示我国全部工业增加值总体上升，折线表示增长速度有起伏，2010年增长率为12.1%。再读题干：题目问“可持续增长”需要加大哪方面的“投入”。由图可知工业产值已在增长，但增速并不稳定，因此要保持长期、可持续增长，需要转换增长动力。结合工业发展常识，最能提高生产效率、促进产业升级并支撑长期增长的是科技投入，所以作答为“科技投入”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是“2006—2010年全部工业增加值及其增长速度”的柱线组合图。柱状表示我国全部工业增加值，整体呈上升趋势；折线表示增长速度，标注有12.9、14.9、9.9、8.7、12.1等，说明增速有起伏，题干也指出2010年同比增长12.1%。再推理：工业产值已经增长，但要实现长期、稳定、可持续增长，不能只依赖资源和劳动力等粗放投入，而需要通过技术进步提高生产效率、推动产业升级。因此应加大科技方面的投入。
